# Notebook 00 -- Ingest the LSTM benchmark projections

**What this notebook does (H5 / Objective 5).** Ingests CAMELS-IND-Proj
(Singh et al. 2026, Zenodo 21775597, CC BY 4.0) -- 13 CMIP6 GCMs x 4 SSPs
daily LSTM streamflow 2015--2100 for 472 Peninsular-India catchments (hydroDL
package; historical per-GCM streamflow 1980--2014 included) -- as the
**Track B benchmark object only** (AGENTS.md, two-track design fixed 18 Nov
2026):

* Track B is the *audited object of H5* -- never substrate, never input to
  our models, and **LSTM series are never treated as observed truth**;
* their forcings inherit the Mishra et al. (2020) South-Asia bias correction
  (documented in their data description) -- one more reason they can never
  be our substrate (our Track A correction is catchment-tuned, seasonal,
  out-of-sample-ranked).

Steps (layout discovered from the archive, 19 Nov 2026 -- no hardcoded
assumptions survived into the extraction code):

1. **Integrity + selective unpack.** Verify byte size and CRC, then unpack
   *only* the aggregate streamflow CSVs (`<GCM>/<scenario>/Streamflow_projected.csv`),
   not the 35 GB tree. The archive is **Zip64 (> 4 GiB)**: Info-ZIP `unzip`
   mis-parses it and R's internal `unz` refuses it (error -103), so 7-Zip is
   the extraction engine and that choice is recorded in the log.
2. **Structure discovery + claim checks.** Walk the full archive listing into
   `data_processed/bench/zip_inventory.csv`, then score two brief claims
   against the data rather than against prose: the "239 confidence-flagged
   catchments" claim, and the GCM overlap between their 13 models and our
   14-model shortlist.
3. **Extraction.** For every Tier 1/2 catchment in the HYD roster x every GCM
   x every scenario, pull the daily LSTM streamflow, convert **cumecs ->
   mm/day** with the CAMELS-IND `area_km2` (the same area used by
   GR4J/GR6J), and cache one rds per catchment under
   `data_processed/bench/q_lstm/<id>.rds`. A unit-sanity check against the
   observed record is written, not just asserted.
4. **Provenance stamp.** Every cache carries `source =
   "CAMELS-IND-Proj LSTM (Track B benchmark)"`, the zenodo DOI, the
   GCM/scenario keys, and the unit-conversion constant. The H5 evaluator
   (BENCH_10) consumes these caches only.

```{r log-file}
bench_output_dir <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "bench")
dir.create(bench_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
bench_log_file <- file.path(bench_output_dir, "bench_00_log.txt")
bench_log <- function(msg) {
   line <- paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), " | ", msg)
   cat(line, "\n"); cat(line, "\n", file = bench_log_file, append = TRUE)
}
```

## 1. Configuration

```{r config}
bench_zip_fp   <- "D:/Datasets/CAMELS_IND_Proj/CAMELS-IND-Proj_data.zip"
bench_extract  <- "D:/Datasets/CAMELS_IND_Proj/extract"
bench_expected_bytes <- 11293105215   # Zenodo record 21775597 file size
bench_test_mode <- FALSE              # TRUE: 3 catchments x 2 GCMs x 1 SSP
bench_log(paste0("BENCH_00 start | zip: ", bench_zip_fp))
```

## 2. Archive integrity + selective unpack

```{r unzip, eval=TRUE}
stopifnot(file.exists(bench_zip_fp))
zip_size <- as.double(file.size(bench_zip_fp))
bench_log(paste0("zip size on disk: ", zip_size, " bytes (expected ",
                 bench_expected_bytes, ")"))
# Multi-connection downloaders (aria2c) write sparse segments ahead of the
# completed bytes, so an almost-full file size proves nothing. Two guards:
#   (a) no aria2 control file may remain (it exists while downloading),
#   (b) the archive must pass a real CRC test before unpacking.
aria2_ctrl <- paste0(bench_zip_fp, ".aria2")
if (file.exists(aria2_ctrl)) stop(paste0(
   "download still in progress: aria2 control file present (", aria2_ctrl,
   "). Wait for aria2c to exit cleanly."))
if (zip_size < bench_expected_bytes) stop(paste0(
   "zip incomplete: ", zip_size, " < ", bench_expected_bytes,
   " bytes -- resume the download before running BENCH_00"))

# Extraction engine. This archive is Zip64 and > 4 GiB: Info-ZIP `unzip`
# mis-parses the central-directory offsets ("extra bytes at beginning ...
# zipfile corrupt") and R's internal unz fails with error -103. 7-Zip reads
# it correctly, so 7-Zip is used and the choice is logged.
find_7z <- function() {
   cand <- c(Sys.which("7z"), Sys.which("7za"),
             "C:/Program Files/7-Zip/7z.exe", "C:/tools/7z.exe")
   cand <- cand[nzchar(cand) & file.exists(cand)]
   if (!length(cand)) NA_character_ else cand[1]
}
bench_7z <- find_7z()
if (is.na(bench_7z)) stop("7-Zip not found: install 7-Zip or add 7z.exe to PATH")
bench_log(paste0("extraction engine: ", bench_7z, " (Zip64 archive; unzip/unz cannot read it)"))

bench_log("running archive CRC test (7z t) ...")
t_out <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
t_status <- system2(bench_7z, c("t", shQuote(bench_zip_fp)),
                    stdout = t_out, stderr = t_out)
if (!identical(as.integer(t_status), 0L)) stop(paste0(
   "archive integrity test FAILED (7z t exit ", t_status, "): ",
   paste(utils::tail(readLines(t_out, warn = FALSE), 3), collapse = " | ")))
bench_log("archive integrity test passed")

if (!dir.exists(bench_extract)) dir.create(bench_extract, recursive = TRUE)
sf_present <- list.files(bench_extract, pattern = "^Streamflow.*\\.csv$",
                         recursive = TRUE)
if (!length(sf_present)) {
   bench_log("unpacking aggregate streamflow CSVs only (not the 35 GB tree) ...")
   x_out <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
   x_status <- system2(bench_7z,
      c("x", "-y", paste0("-o", bench_extract), shQuote(bench_zip_fp),
        "-ir!Streamflow*.csv"), stdout = x_out, stderr = x_out)
   if (!identical(as.integer(x_status), 0L)) stop(paste0(
      "unpack FAILED (7z x exit ", x_status, "): ",
      paste(utils::tail(readLines(x_out, warn = FALSE), 3), collapse = " | ")))
   bench_log("unpack complete")
} else {
   bench_log(paste0("aggregate streamflow CSVs already present (", length(sf_present),
                    ") -- skipping unpack"))
}
sf_present <- list.files(bench_extract, pattern = "^Streamflow.*\\.csv$",
                         recursive = TRUE)
cat("streamflow CSVs on disk:", length(sf_present), "\n")
```

## 3. Structure discovery + claim checks

```{r inventory, eval=TRUE}
# Full archive listing (30k+ entries) parsed from `7z l -ba -slt`, so the
# inventory describes the archive, not a half-unpacked tree.
inv_fp <- file.path(bench_output_dir, "zip_inventory.csv")
if (!file.exists(inv_fp)) {
   bench_log("building archive inventory (7z l -ba -slt) ...")
   l_out <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
   l_status <- system2(bench_7z, c("l", "-ba", "-slt", shQuote(bench_zip_fp)),
                       stdout = l_out, stderr = l_out)
   if (!identical(as.integer(l_status), 0L)) stop("archive listing failed")
   ln <- readLines(l_out, warn = FALSE)
   inv <- data.table::data.table(
      rel_path = gsub("\\\\", "/", sub("^Path = ", "", ln[startsWith(ln, "Path = ")])),
      size_bytes = as.numeric(sub("^Size = ", "", ln[startsWith(ln, "Size = ")])),
      is_dir = sub("^Folder = ", "", ln[startsWith(ln, "Folder = ")]) == "+")
   inv <- inv[rel_path != ""]
   inv[, ext := tools::file_ext(rel_path)]
   inv[, depth := vapply(strsplit(rel_path, "/"), length, integer(1))]
   inv[, top_dir := vapply(strsplit(rel_path, "/"), `[`, character(1), 1)]
   data.table::fwrite(inv, inv_fp)
   bench_log(paste0("inventory written: ", nrow(inv), " entries, ",
                    sum(inv$is_dir), " dirs, ", sum(!inv$is_dir), " files"))
}
inv <- data.table::fread(inv_fp)
cat("archive entries:", nrow(inv), "| files:", sum(inv$is_dir == FALSE),
    "| uncompressed bytes:", format(sum(inv$size_bytes), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("top-level entries:\n"); print(sort(unique(inv$top_dir)))
cat("extensions:\n");        print(table(inv$ext, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r grid, eval=TRUE}
# The layout is <root>/<GCM>/<scenario>/{Streamflow_projected.csv,02_Forcing_Data/<id>.csv}
fl <- inv[is_dir == FALSE & depth >= 4]
fl[, gcm := vapply(strsplit(rel_path, "/"), `[`, character(1), 2)]
fl[, scenario := vapply(strsplit(rel_path, "/"), `[`, character(1), 3)]
fl[, fname := basename(rel_path)]

bench_gcms <- sort(unique(fl[grepl("^ssp[0-9]+$|^historical$", scenario), gcm]))
bench_scenarios <- sort(unique(fl[grepl("^ssp[0-9]+$|^historical$", scenario),
                                 scenario]))
cat("GCMs in archive (", length(bench_gcms), "):\n", sep = ""); print(bench_gcms)
cat("scenarios (", length(bench_scenarios), "):\n", sep = ""); print(bench_scenarios)

agg <- fl[fname == "Streamflow_projected.csv"]
dup <- fl[grepl("Streamflow_projected", fname) & fname != "Streamflow_projected.csv"]
cat("\naggregate streamflow files:", nrow(agg),
    "| expected GCM x scenario:", length(bench_gcms) * length(bench_scenarios), "\n")
if (nrow(dup)) {
   bench_log(paste0("duplicate aggregate files ignored (non-canonical name): ",
                    paste(dup$rel_path, collapse = "; ")))
   cat("ignored duplicate files:\n"); print(dup$rel_path)
}
data.table::fwrite(agg[, .(gcm, scenario, rel_path, size_bytes)],
                   file.path(bench_output_dir, "archive_grid.csv"))
```

```{r claim-checks, eval=TRUE}
# --- Claim 1: "239 confidence-flagged catchments" (project brief) ----------
conf_hits <- inv[grepl("confid|flag|nan|mask|qual", rel_path, ignore.case = TRUE),
                 rel_path]
if (length(conf_hits)) {
   cat("confidence/flag-like files found:\n"); print(conf_hits)
   bench_log(paste0("claim check (confidence flags): candidates present: ",
                    paste(conf_hits, collapse = "; ")))
} else {
   bench_log(paste0("claim check (confidence flags): FAILED -- no confidence/flag/NaN-mask ",
                    "file exists anywhere in the archive; the '239 confidence-flagged ",
                    "catchments' brief claim is NOT supported by the distributed data ",
                    "and must be re-scored against the data-description PDF or withdrawn"))
   cat("NO confidence/flag-like file in the archive -> brief claim unsupported\n")
}
# a flag could also be a column: the aggregate streamflow header is
# year,month,day + one column per catchment, nothing else.
probe_hdr <- names(data.table::fread(file.path(bench_extract, agg$rel_path[1]),
                                     nrows = 0L))
non_gauge <- probe_hdr[!grepl("^[0-9]+\\.0$", probe_hdr)]
cat("non-gauge columns in the aggregate streamflow header:\n"); print(non_gauge)
bench_log(paste0("claim check (confidence flags): aggregate header columns = ",
                 paste(non_gauge, collapse = ","), " + ",
                 sum(grepl("^[0-9]+\\.0$", probe_hdr)), " gauge columns; no flag column"))

# --- Claim 2: GCM overlap with our 14-model shortlist ---------------------
shortlist <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_output_dir, "model_shortlist_final.csv"))
shortlist <- shortlist[selected == 1, model]
# their naming differs for one model (resolution suffix dropped)
bench_alias <- c("EC-Earth3-Veg" = "EC-Earth3-Veg-LR")
bench_gcms_mapped <- ifelse(bench_gcms %in% names(bench_alias),
                            bench_alias[bench_gcms], bench_gcms)
shared <- intersect(bench_gcms_mapped, shortlist)
cat("\nour shortlist (", length(shortlist), "): ", paste(shortlist, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("their GCMs (", length(bench_gcms), "): ", paste(bench_gcms, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("shared (", length(shared), "): ", paste(shared, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("theirs but not ours:", paste(setdiff(bench_gcms_mapped, shortlist), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("ours but not theirs:", paste(setdiff(shortlist, bench_gcms_mapped), collapse = ", "), "\n")
bench_log(paste0("GCM overlap with our shortlist: ", length(shared), " of ",
                 length(shortlist), " (", paste(shared, collapse = ","),
                 "); H5 like-for-like comparison must be restricted to these"))
data.table::fwrite(data.table::data.table(
   archive_gcm = bench_gcms, mapped_to_our_name = bench_gcms_mapped,
   in_our_shortlist = bench_gcms_mapped %in% shortlist),
   file.path(bench_output_dir, "gcm_overlap.csv"))
```

## 4. Extraction (cumecs -> mm/day) into per-catchment caches

```{r extract, eval=TRUE}
inputs_sum <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_inputs_summary.csv"),
                                colClasses = list(character = "id"))
roster <- inputs_sum[, .(id, area_km2)]
if (bench_test_mode) roster <- roster[1:3]
# our ids are zero-padded 5-digit strings ("03002"); their column headers are
# numeric ("3002.0") -- the join key is the integer value, and unmatched
# catchments are logged, never dropped silently.
roster[, id_int := as.integer(id)]

# one aggregate file at a time -> days x catchments matrix in mm/day
read_agg_mm <- function(fp, rid_int, area) {
   hdr <- names(data.table::fread(fp, nrows = 0L))
   gi  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(hdr))
   keep <- which(gi %in% rid_int)
   if (!length(keep)) return(NULL)
   d <- data.table::fread(fp, select = hdr[c(1:3, keep)])
   dates <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-%02d", d[["year"]], d[["month"]], d[["day"]]))
   q <- as.matrix(d[, (3L + seq_along(keep)), with = FALSE])
   ids <- sprintf("%05d", gi[keep])
   # sweep() across COLUMNS: `q * 86.4 / area` would recycle the area vector
   # down the rows (days) instead of across catchments -- that silent bug is
   # what the unit check below is designed to catch.
   q_mm <- sweep(q, 2L, area[match(ids, roster$id)], "/") * 86.4
   list(dates = dates, q = q_mm, ids = ids)
}

agg[, scenario := as.character(scenario)]
agg_hist <- agg[scenario == "historical"]
agg_proj <- agg[scenario != "historical"]
agg_hist[, fp := file.path(bench_extract, rel_path)]
agg_proj[, fp := file.path(bench_extract, rel_path)]
# keep the canonical file when a duplicate slipped into the archive
agg_proj <- agg_proj[!grepl(" - Copy", fname)]
if (bench_test_mode) {
   agg_hist <- agg_hist[1:1]; agg_proj <- agg_proj[1:1]
}

bench_log(paste0("reading ", nrow(agg_hist), " historical + ", nrow(agg_proj),
                 " projected aggregate files"))

hist_q <- list(); hist_dates <- NULL; hist_ids <- NULL
for (i in seq_len(nrow(agg_hist))) {
   r <- read_agg_mm(agg_hist$fp[i], roster$id_int, roster$area_km2)
   hist_q[[agg_hist$gcm[i]]] <- r$q
   hist_dates <- r$dates; hist_ids <- r$ids
   cat("  historical", agg_hist$gcm[i], ":", nrow(r$q), "days x", ncol(r$q),
       "catchments\n")
}
cat("historical coverage:", format(min(hist_dates)), "to", format(max(hist_dates)), "\n")
```

```{r unit-check, eval=TRUE}
# Do not assert the unit conversion -- measure it against the observed record.
# If the archive were already mm/day, the converted means would be off by a
# factor of ~area/86.4 (orders of magnitude), which this check would expose.
unit_rows <- list()
for (cid in utils::head(roster$id, 20)) {
   obsf <- file.path(hyd_inputs_dir, paste0(cid, "_obs.csv"))
   if (!file.exists(obsf)) next
   obs <- data.table::fread(obsf, select = c("date", "Qobs_mm"))
   obs[, date := as.Date(date)]
   w <- obs[date >= hyd_valid_start & date <= hyd_valid_end]
   if (!nrow(w)) next
   qbar_obs <- mean(w$Qobs_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
   qbar_lstm <- mean(vapply(hist_q, function(m) mean(m[, match(cid, hist_ids)], na.rm = TRUE),
                            numeric(1)), na.rm = TRUE)
   unit_rows[[length(unit_rows) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
      catchment = cid, obs_mean_mm = round(qbar_obs, 4),
      lstm_mean_mm = round(qbar_lstm, 4),
      ratio = round(qbar_lstm / qbar_obs, 3))
}
unit_chk <- data.table::rbindlist(unit_rows)
data.table::fwrite(unit_chk, file.path(bench_output_dir, "unit_check.csv"))
cat("unit sanity (LSTM/obs mean flow, mm/day, 2001-2014):\n")
print(summary(unit_chk$ratio))
unit_median <- stats::median(unit_chk$ratio)
# A conversion error (wrong area alignment, wrong unit, wrong factor) shows up
# here as an order-of-magnitude median. A benchmark LSTM can be biased, but not
# by 4x in the median -- so this is a hard gate, not a note in the log.
if (!is.finite(unit_median) || unit_median < 0.25 || unit_median > 4) {
   stop(paste0("unit check FAILED: median LSTM/obs mean-flow ratio = ",
               round(unit_median, 3), " (expected 0.25-4). The cumecs -> mm/day ",
               "conversion or the gauge-column alignment is wrong; do not use ",
               "these caches."))
}
bench_log(paste0("unit check: median LSTM/obs mean-flow ratio = ",
                 round(unit_median, 3),
                 " (range ", round(min(unit_chk$ratio), 2), "-",
                 round(max(unit_chk$ratio), 2),
                 "); conversion cumecs -> mm/day = q * 86.4 / area_km2 confirmed"))
```

```{r projections, eval=TRUE}
# Projection pass: window summaries (the H5 low-flow envelope) + a staged
# daily matrix per GCM x SSP so later modules never need to touch the zip.
stage_dir <- file.path(bench_output_dir, "q_stage")
dir.create(stage_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
win_defs <- list(near = c("2015-01-01", "2040-12-31"),
                 mid  = c("2041-01-01", "2060-12-31"),
                 long = c("2081-01-01", "2100-12-31"))

proj_rows <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(agg_proj))) {
   g <- agg_proj$gcm[i]; s <- agg_proj$scenario[i]
   r <- read_agg_mm(agg_proj$fp[i], roster$id_int, roster$area_km2)
   # compress = FALSE: bulk series are regenerable (repo convention) and
   # gzip on a 61 MB matrix per file would cost more CPU than the disk saves
   saveRDS(list(gcm = g, scenario = s, dates = r$dates, ids = r$ids, q_mm = r$q),
           file.path(stage_dir, paste0(g, "__", s, ".rds")), compress = FALSE)
   for (wn in names(win_defs)) {
      wd <- win_defs[[wn]]
      ii <- which(r$dates >= as.Date(wd[1]) & r$dates <= as.Date(wd[2]))
      if (!length(ii)) next
      sub <- r$q[ii, , drop = FALSE]
      proj_rows[[length(proj_rows) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
         catchment = r$ids, gcm = g, ssp = s, window = wn,
         n_days = length(ii),
         q05_mm  = apply(sub, 2, stats::quantile, probs = 0.05, names = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
         q10_mm  = apply(sub, 2, stats::quantile, probs = 0.10, names = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
         q50_mm  = apply(sub, 2, stats::quantile, probs = 0.50, names = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
         mam7_mm = apply(sub, 2, function(v) min(data.table::frollmean(v, 7), na.rm = TRUE)),
         mean_mm = colMeans(sub, na.rm = TRUE))
   }
   if (i %% 10 == 0) cat("  ...", i, "of", nrow(agg_proj), "\n")
}
proj_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(proj_rows)
data.table::fwrite(proj_summary, file.path(bench_output_dir, "lstm_proj_summary.csv"))
cat("projection summary rows:", nrow(proj_summary), "\n")
bench_log(paste0("projection summaries: ", nrow(proj_summary), " rows (",
                 data.table::uniqueN(proj_summary$gcm), " GCMs x ",
                 data.table::uniqueN(proj_summary$ssp), " SSPs x ",
                 data.table::uniqueN(proj_summary$window), " windows)"))
```

```{r cache-write, eval=TRUE}
q_dir <- file.path(bench_output_dir, "q_lstm")
dir.create(q_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

excl <- list()
miss_col <- setdiff(roster$id, hist_ids)
if (length(miss_col)) {
   excl[[length(excl) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
      module = "BENCH_00", catchment = miss_col,
      reason_code = "no_streamflow_column",
      detail = "roster id absent from the archive's aggregate streamflow columns")
}
n_written <- 0L
# chunked so peak memory stays ~1 GCM x 50 catchments, not the full cube
chunks <- split(roster$id, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(roster)) / 50))
for (ch in chunks) {
   for (cid in ch) {
      j <- match(cid, hist_ids)
      if (is.na(j)) next
      series <- list()
      for (g in names(hist_q)) {
         qv <- hist_q[[g]][, j]
         series[[paste0(g, "/historical")]] <- data.table::data.table(
            date = hist_dates, q = qv)
      }
      saveRDS(list(
         id = cid,
         area_km2 = roster$area_km2[match(cid, roster$id)],
         source = "CAMELS-IND-Proj LSTM (Track B benchmark)",
         doi = "10.5281/zenodo.21775597",
         unit = "mm/day (converted from cumecs, factor 86.4/area_km2)",
         n_gap_filled = sum(vapply(series, function(s) sum(is.na(s$q)), integer(1))),
         series = series,
         proj = proj_summary[catchment == cid][order(gcm, ssp, window)]),
         file.path(q_dir, paste0(cid, ".rds")), compress = FALSE)
      n_written <- n_written + 1L
   }
   cat("  cached", n_written, "of", nrow(roster), "\n")
}

excl_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(excl, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(excl_dt)) {
   data.table::fwrite(excl_dt, file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed",
                                         "logs", "BENCH_00_exclusions.csv"))
}
bench_log(paste0("BENCH_00 done: cached ", n_written, " catchments | excluded ",
                 nrow(excl_dt), " | staged daily projection files: ",
                 length(list.files(stage_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$"))))
cat("cached:", n_written, "| excluded:", nrow(excl_dt), "\n")
```

## Take-away

- `data_processed/bench/q_lstm/<id>.rds` -- per-catchment LSTM cache:
  historical daily series per GCM (mm/day, provenance-stamped, Track B
  benchmark only) plus the per-SSP window low-flow summaries (`proj`).
- `data_processed/bench/q_stage/<GCM>__<ssp>.rds` -- staged daily projection
  matrices, so later drought/SRI modules never have to touch the 11 GB zip.
- `zip_inventory.csv` / `archive_grid.csv` / `gcm_overlap.csv` /
  `unit_check.csv` -- the discovered structure and the two claim checks,
  auditable, with the reasoning in `bench_00_log.txt`.
- Two findings that constrain H5 and must reach the paper: (i) the archive
  contains **no confidence-flag object**, so the brief's "239
  confidence-flagged catchments" claim is unsupported by the distributed data;
  (ii) the benchmark shares only **8** of our 14 shortlisted GCMs, so the H5
  like-for-like comparison must be restricted to that intersection.
- `BENCH_10_lowflow_eval.Rmd` applies the same `metric_version v1` suite to
  these series and writes `h5_verdict.md` against the pre-registered H5 rule.
